projects.title: ViDoctor
projects.description:
◦ won 1st place @ umass hackathon
• developed a webite to allow video meetings between doctors of nearby hospitals and patients using React and Node.js.
◦ located nearby hospitals using Google Maps API and implemented video meetings using Twilio.

projects.title: ecommerce app for iOS
projects.description:
◦ implemented an Ecommerce App for iOS that merges items from shopping platforms like Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce using Swift, SwiftUI, MongoDB, AlamoFire
◦ built chat functionality using Chatto and connect with 3P providers using Kitura and Safari Services.
◦ developed payment method so users can purchase products directly with their Apple Wallet using Apple Pay API and PassKit.
